title: cookies() is now asynchronous in Next.js 15
description: In Next.js 15, cookies() is an asynchronous function that returns a Promise. Calling it synchronously or accessing properties without await is deprecated and will fail in production.

remediation.summary: Await the cookies() call before accessing methods like .get() or .set().
remediation.exampleBefore:
const cookieStore = cookies();
const token = cookieStore.get('token');
remediation.exampleAfter:
const cookieStore = await cookies();
const token = cookieStore.get('token');

title: headers() is now asynchronous in Next.js 15
description: In Next.js 15, headers() is an asynchronous function that returns a Promise. Synchronous calls must be converted to async/await.

remediation.summary: Add await before headers() and mark the enclosing function async.
remediation.exampleBefore:
const headersList = headers();
const auth = headersList.get('authorization');
remediation.exampleAfter:
const headersList = await headers();
const auth = headersList.get('authorization');

title: draftMode() is now asynchronous in Next.js 15
description: draftMode() returns a Promise in Next.js 15. Calling it synchronously or accessing properties like .isEnabled without await is deprecated and will fail in production.

remediation.summary: Add await before draftMode() and ensure the enclosing scope is async.

title: request.geo removed from NextRequest
description: The geo property has been removed from NextRequest. Use the geolocation helper from the @vercel/functions package or platform-specific headers.

remediation.summary: Import geolocation from @vercel/functions and pass the request object.

title: request.ip removed from NextRequest
description: The ip property has been removed from NextRequest. Use the ipAddress helper from the @vercel/functions package or inspect the x-forwarded-for header.

remediation.summary: Import ipAddress from @vercel/functions and pass the request object.

title: fetch() caching default changed from cached to uncached
description: In Next.js 15, fetch requests are uncached by default (cache: 'no-store' instead of 'force-cache'). If static caching is required, explicitly opt in.

remediation.summary: Explicitly specify { cache: 'force-cache' } or { next: { revalidate: ... } } if cached responses are intended.
remediation.exampleBefore:
// In Next.js 14, this was cached by default:
const res = await fetch('https://api.example.com/data');

title: GET Route Handlers are no longer cached by default
description: GET Route Handlers in Next.js 15 are uncached by default and execute on every request unless configured with export const dynamic = 'force-static'.

remediation.summary: Export dynamic = 'force-static' if static generation / caching is intended for this route handler.

title: next/router import is unsupported in App Router directory
description: Importing useRouter from 'next/router' causes a runtime crash when rendered in App Router routes (app/**). Use 'next/navigation' instead.

title: Deprecated layout and objectFit props on <Image>
description: Legacy props 'layout' and 'objectFit' on next/image are removed. Use the boolean 'fill' prop and standard style attribute.

remediation.summary: Replace layout="fill" with fill, and objectFit with style={{ objectFit: '...' }}.

title: next/legacy/image module removed
description: The next/legacy/image module has been completely removed in Next.js 15. Migrate to next/image.

remediation.summary: Change import to next/image and adapt legacy props to modern fill/style attributes.

title: @next/font package removed in favor of built-in next/font
description: The separate @next/font package is removed in Next.js 15. Use the built-in next/font module.

title: useFormState replaced by useActionState in React 19
description: In React 19 (required by Next.js 15), useFormState from react-dom is deprecated in favor of useActionState from react.

remediation.summary: Replace useFormState from 'react-dom' with useActionState from 'react'.
remediation.exampleBefore:
import { useFormState } from 'react-dom';
const [state, formAction] = useFormState(fn, initialState);
remediation.exampleAfter:
import { useActionState } from 'react';
const [state, formAction, isPending] = useActionState(fn, initialState);

title: unstable_after stabilized to after()
description: unstable_after from next/server has been stabilized as after().

remediation.summary: Import after instead of unstable_after from 'next/server'.

title: experimental.serverExternalPackages moved to root serverExternalPackages
description: experimental.serverExternalPackages in next.config.js has been stabilized and moved to root serverExternalPackages.

remediation.summary: Move serverExternalPackages out of experimental to the root next.config level.

title: swcMinify removed from next.config.js
description: The swcMinify configuration option in next.config.js has been removed. SWC minification is enabled by default.
